mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, it is 37 degrees and clear near Reddan Soccer Park. We have a waxing crescent moon in the sky, and we are expecting an overnight low of 31 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has released general election notices for the upcoming year, and the Plan Commission is preparing to review several development proposals including a site plan and traffic impact analysis for the Sub-Zero project at Liberty Business Park on December 7th.

We have a packed schedule with Yoga at Insight Wellness today, Art House 360 Thursday nights today, and Hop Haus Trivia happening today as well. Looking ahead, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run tomorrow and the Dane County Farmers Market this Saturday.

In a recent report, officers noted that on October 25th, they discovered a 40-year-old man who had been stopped at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue for over 20 minutes, leading to his arrest for an O W I first offence.
It is a great day to stop by the local Culver's to enjoy today's flavor, Devil's Food Cake. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving until 10 PM tonight.
